text.arabic_uthmani: تَرَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌۢ بِهِمْ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فِى رَوْضَاتِ ٱلْجَنَّاتِ ۖ لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ

words.gloss_range: direct witnessing and moral perception: a present-tense seeing that governs the wrongdoers and their visible state
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, recognizing, and judging; here selected as direct witnessing with moral perception
words.prose: {{ar:تَرَى}} ({{tr:tarā}}) opens the ayah as direct witnessing. Its imperfect address makes the scene present, and its grammar takes both the wrongdoers and their visible fear-state into view, so seeing becomes moral inspection as well as sight. The same seeing channel can frame eschatological spectacle (22:2), while here it narrows the spectacle to exposed wrongdoers.

topics.headline: direct witnessed tableau
topics.reader_payoff: The reader is made to see the wrongdoers as a present moral spectacle, not merely hear a report about them.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 1 converge on direct witnessed tableau; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: recognized class of wrongdoers, accusative under sight, whose injustice is seen returning as exposure and liability
words.root_gloss_range: wronging, injustice, and misplacing due measure; here embodied as a known active-participle group
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ẓālimīna}}) is definite and accusative, so the opening vision places a known class under inspection. The active participle makes injustice an identifying state, and the ayah shows that misplaced measure returning on its agents as fear and impact. The same class-language continues the local wrongdoer thread and anticipates the visible humiliation of wrongdoers later in the surah (42:45).

topics.headline: known wrongdoer class under sight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a recognized class of wrongdoers placed under public vision before the believing countergroup is unfolded.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 2 converge on known wrongdoer class under sight; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: sustained apprehensive concern, functioning as the visible circumstantial state of the wrongdoers
words.root_gloss_range: apprehension, anxious concern, and solicitude; here the field becomes exposed fear over consequence
words.prose: {{ar:مُشْفِقِينَ}} ({{tr:mushfiqīna}}) is the circumstantial state of the wrongdoers, making apprehension the first visible sign of judgment. The Form IV active participle keeps fear as an ongoing posture, and the root-field gives it the texture of anxious concern over what their own earning has made unavoidable. The fear-field can mark hidden pious awe elsewhere (21:49), but here it is transferred to exposed liability.

topics.headline: fear as exposed circumstance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees fear not as an added explanation but as the very condition in which the wrongdoers are displayed.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 3 converge on fear as exposed circumstance; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: contracted source-cause phrase linking apprehension to the broad matter of what was acquired
words.prose: {{ar:مِمَّا}} ({{tr:mimmā}}) fuses the source preposition with an open relative content word. It attaches the wrongdoers’ apprehension to what they acquired, so the fear comes from and because of their own record rather than from an unnamed force. The compact form makes cause and source feel inseparable from the earning that follows.

topics.headline: fear tied to its earned source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can trace the fear backward to its source rather than treating it as arbitrary terror.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 4 converge on fear tied to its earned source; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: completed collective acquisition whose broad object becomes owned liability for the wrongdoers
words.root_gloss_range: earning, acquiring, gaining, and making something one’s own; here the gain-field darkens into liability
words.prose: {{ar:كَسَبُوا۟}} ({{tr:kasabū}}) presents completed group acquisition, with the open object supplied by the preceding relative phrase. The gain-field turns dark here: what was acquired becomes owned liability. The principle that persons meet what they earn appears clearly elsewhere (2:286), and this ayah dramatizes it by moving from earning to falling impact, then later contrasting it with surplus bounty.

topics.headline: earning turned into liability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the feared outcome belongs to the wrongdoers as something they themselves acquired.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 5 converge on earning turned into liability; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: circumstantial or resumptive connector that joins visible fear to the simultaneous or accompanying arriving consequence
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the next clause as a tight hinge. It can be heard circumstantially or resumptively, and either way it keeps the feared outcome simultaneous with, and accompanying, the visible fear-state. The result is not a pause after emotion but a compressed move from apprehension to impact.

topics.headline: hinge from fear to impact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the anxious state joined to the actuality already bearing down on them, rather than separated into a later scene.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 6 converge on hinge from fear to impact; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: detached pronoun anchoring the nominal clause and compressing the feared matter or punishment before the predicate names its occurrence
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) anchors the nominal clause before the predicate arrives. The pronoun keeps the feared matter or punishment co-present without renaming it, so the sentence briefly compresses the whole consequence and then states that it is falling upon them. Its compactness also links the prior verdict-boundary to the present scene.

topics.headline: pronoun holding the consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the feared outcome held in a compact pronoun before its impact is named.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 7 converge on pronoun holding the consequence; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: actual occurrence as a durable falling impact directed toward the wrongdoers
words.root_gloss_range: occurring, falling, taking place, and landing; here selected as active realization with impact
words.prose: {{ar:وَاقِعٌۢ}} ({{tr:wāqiʿun}}) is a nominative active participle predicate: the consequence is not imagined but actually occurring. The root gives occurrence the image of landing or falling, and the following contact phrase directs that impact onto the same group. The eschatological falling-event language is recognizable from 56:1, while here the form localizes it as the wrongdoers’ realized outcome.

topics.headline: actual falling impact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the consequence move from feared possibility into objective, landing actuality.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 8 converge on actual falling impact; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: contact preposition attaching the falling consequence to its affected target
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the falling occurrence to its target. Its contact force makes affectedness explicit: the consequence is not merely in their vicinity but bears on them. This adverse contact also prepares the later reversal where another preposition marks benefit for the believing group.

topics.headline: impact attached to its target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears consequence as contact with the wrongdoers, not as a detached event near them.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 9 converge on impact attached to its target; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: plural pronoun returning the impact to the already seen wrongdoers
words.prose: {{ar:هِمْ}} ({{tr:him}}) returns the prepositional target to the wrongdoers already placed under sight. The pronoun seals the first half around one group: they are seen, afraid, and then directly affected. That plural suffix prepares a sharp role reversal when the believer group later receives its own plural beneficiary marker.

topics.headline: same group sealed under consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can track the same wrongdoers from public sight to fear to direct impact.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 10 converge on same group sealed under consequence; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening the contrasted believer clause after the wrongdoer consequence
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) starts the countergroup clause. After fear and impact have enclosed the wrongdoers, this conjunction pivots to those characterized by faith and sound deeds. The structure sets up a two-outcome contrast: acquired liability on one side, bounty on the other.

topics.headline: pivot to the countergroup
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah turn from earned liability to the opposite group and its reward sphere.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 11 converge on pivot to the countergroup; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: definite plural relative pronoun whose following predicates define the rewarded class before its location is given
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) heads the believer-side subject, but it does not stand alone. Its relative clause defines the group through what follows before the reward location appears. The grammar makes identity enacted: these are the ones who believe and do sound deeds, not an undefined counterparty.

topics.headline: class defined by its predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader waits for the group to be defined by faith and deeds before hearing where they are placed.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 12 converge on class defined by its predicates; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: objectless Form IV believing as committed entry into trust and security before action and reward are named
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, fidelity, and being safe; here realized as believing commitment opposed to fear
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) gives the first qualification of the rewarded group. The objectless Form IV makes committed trust broad rather than tied to a single stated object, and its security-field answers the fear-field of the opening scene. The familiar faith-and-work reward formula appears elsewhere with gardens (2:25), and here the same pattern starts the movement toward reward.

topics.headline: faith answered by security
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the believer side begin with trust-security language directly opposite the wrongdoers’ fear.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 13 converge on faith answered by security; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction binding faith to performed sound action within the same relative clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the two verbs inside the relative clause. It gives action its own qualifying force while keeping it bound to faith. The result is a single faith-work profile before the ayah moves into the reward location.

topics.headline: faith joined to action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader does not split inner trust from outward practice; the grammar keeps them together in one qualification.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 14 converge on faith joined to action; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: completed collective action, specified and bounded by the sound deeds that follow
words.root_gloss_range: working, doing, producing, and acting; here direct performed practice whose value is specified by its object
words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) is direct completed group action, coordinated with believing and completed by its object. The word makes faith visible as output, while the following sound-deeds term specifies the value of the work. The faith-work unit is a major Quranic reward pattern, and this ayah carries it forward into the next ayah as well.

topics.headline: faith embodied in work
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees belief become enacted practice before reward is described.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 15 converge on faith embodied in work; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: substantive feminine plural object: sound, fit, repaired deeds as the enacted content of the group’s work
words.root_gloss_range: soundness, fitness, repair, reconciliation, and putting right; here concretized as deeds that qualify the workers
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}) is the object of the action verb, so soundness becomes the content enacted by the believers. The feminine plural substantive leaves the noun for deeds implicit but clear, and the repair-fitness field gives the work a value-shape. Its plural pattern also leads smoothly into the plural garden setting that follows.

topics.headline: soundness as enacted content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the work is not generic activity; it is bounded by deeds marked as sound and fitting.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 16 converge on soundness as enacted content; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition introducing the believers’ delayed predicate as containment within the reward sphere
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) introduces the delayed locative predicate for the believer group. Instead of consequence bearing upon them, they are placed within a reward sphere. The prepositional reversal is tight: adverse contact marked the wrongdoers, while containment now frames the believers.

topics.headline: contained reward location
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the counter-outcome as placement inside reward, reversing the earlier adverse contact.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 17 converge on contained reward location; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: plural meadow spaces in construct with the gardens, giving the reward location watered, open abundance
words.root_gloss_range: meadow, watered garden-ground, and cultivated spaciousness; here a rare plural construct specializing paradise imagery
words.prose: {{ar:رَوْضَاتِ}} ({{tr:rawḍāti}}) gives the reward location a rare meadow texture. As a plural construct before the garden noun, it layers meadow spaces inside the larger garden field. The image suggests watered abundance and openness before the ayah turns to what the believers have there.

topics.headline: meadows within gardens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the reward setting as layered meadow-space, not just a generic garden label.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 18 converge on meadows within gardens; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: definite plural gardens as protected, abundant enclosures completing the meadow construct
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealment, protection, and garden enclosure; here selected as known plural garden reward
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجَنَّاتِ}} ({{tr:al-jannāti}}) completes the construct as the known garden setting. The covering-root behind garden language gives the scene enclosure and protection, the opposite of the wrongdoers’ exposed impact. The garden reward pairing with faith and work is familiar from passages such as 2:25, while here it is intensified by the preceding meadow term.

topics.headline: protected garden abundance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the reward as enclosed abundance in contrast with the exposed impact on wrongdoers.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 19 converge on protected garden abundance; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: fronted benefit-possession marker assigning reward content to the believers before that content is named
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) starts a fronted benefit phrase. Before the desired content is named, the relation is assigned to the believers: for them. That fronting reverses the earlier adverse target construction and moves the ayah from impact upon one group to provision for the other.

topics.headline: fronted beneficiary reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the believers’ allocation before its contents, reversing the earlier target relation on the wrongdoers.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 20 converge on fronted beneficiary reversal; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: plural suffix resuming the faith-work group as beneficiaries of the reward content
words.prose: {{ar:هُم}} ({{tr:hum}}) resumes the believer group as beneficiaries. The compact suffix keeps the same people present as the clause moves from gardens to open desired content. Across the ayah, plural pronouns shift roles: one group receives impact, the other receives benefit.

topics.headline: same group carried into benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can track the faith-work group through location, possession, desire, and Lordly nearness.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 21 converge on same group carried into benefit; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: open relative or indefinite content word naming the broad scope of what is available for them
words.prose: {{ar:مَّا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens the content slot after the fronted benefit phrase. It can function as relative or expansive indefinite, and both effects matter locally: the reward is broadly opened as what they will. The breadth remains framed by the Lordly location that follows, so it is expansive without becoming detached appetite.

topics.headline: open content of reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears reward content opened broadly before the act of willing and its Lordly boundary are stated.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 22 converge on open content of reward; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: ongoing plural willing whose object is the open reward content and whose scope is bounded by Lordly nearness
words.root_gloss_range: willing, intending, and thingness-related volition; here human desire is active within divine proximity
words.prose: {{ar:يَشَآءُونَ}} ({{tr:yashāʾūna}}) keeps the believers’ willing ongoing, with the open content word as its object. The root-field brings volition and thingness together: what they will is the content they have. Yet the next phrase locates this breadth with their Lord, so human desire is expansive but held within Lordly proximity.

topics.headline: ongoing desire within Lordly nearness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward includes active willing, but that willing is housed at the Lordly source.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 23 converge on ongoing desire within Lordly nearness; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: adverbial locus of presence, keeping, and valuation governing their Lord and bounding open desire
words.root_gloss_range: at, with, in the presence of, in the keeping of, and in valuation; here selected as adverbial Lordly locus
words.prose: {{ar:عِندَ}} ({{tr:ʿinda}}) governs the Lordly genitive and turns open willing into provision held in presence, authority, and relationship. Its force is adverbial presence, not an unrelated stubbornness branch from the root field. The phrase keeps desire from floating free by placing it with the Lord, a reward-location pattern also visible when gardens and approval are placed with the Lord (3:15).

topics.headline: desire located with the Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees open desire become provision held in presence, authority, and relationship.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 24 converge on desire located with the Lord; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: relational Lordship with plural suffix, completing the reward locus as sustaining authority for the faith-work group
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, ownership, mastery, sustaining, managing, and nurturing to completion; here relationally suffixed to the believers
words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّهِمْ}} ({{tr:rabbihim}}) completes the locus as with their Lord. The construct and suffix personalize Lordship toward the faith-work group, matching the beneficiary relation already stated. The root-field joins ownership and sustaining care, and the word stands as the last concrete reward detail before the demonstrative summary names the whole outcome as bounty.

topics.headline: reward with their sustaining Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward ends not at an abstract place but with their own Lord as source and relationship.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 25 converge on reward with their sustaining Lord; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative gathering the whole reward complex into one evaluable subject
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) points back over the reward complex: gardens, open willing, and Lordly nearness. Its masculine singular form compresses many details into one evaluable subject, and its distance can elevate what it summarizes. The word pivots the ayah from description to verdict.

topics.headline: reward complex gathered for verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader watches the description stop and become a single thing ready to be named.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 26 converge on reward complex gathered for verdict; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: separative or emphatic pronoun sharpening the identity between the summarized reward and the bounty predicate
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) stands between the demonstrative and the predicate as a separator and intensifier. It sharpens the equation: that described outcome is precisely the bounty. The same pronoun form earlier held the wrongdoers’ consequence; here it returns to classify the believers’ reward.

topics.headline: description turned into classification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the reward package classified, not left as a loose list of pleasures.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 27 converge on description turned into classification; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: definite verbal noun classifying the whole reward scene as surplus bounty beyond strict wage logic
words.root_gloss_range: excess, surplus, favor, bounty, and gracious precedence; here the reward complex is named as identifiable bounty
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْفَضْلُ}} ({{tr:al-faḍlu}}) is the predicate that names the whole reward scene. The definite verbal noun makes bounty identifiable and climactic, not one item among the rewards. Its surplus field contrasts with the earlier earning language: wrongdoers face acquired liability, while believers receive favor beyond strict pay-for-performance. Paradise is named as divine bounty elsewhere (57:21), and this ayah shows the components before naming the principle.

topics.headline: surplus bounty beyond wages
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the believer outcome named as gracious surplus, in deliberate contrast with wrongdoers’ earned liability.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 28 converge on surplus bounty beyond wages; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

words.gloss_range: definite qualitative adjective agreeing with the bounty and giving it intrinsic scale, gravity, and finality
words.root_gloss_range: largeness, greatness, gravity, rank, and magnification; here greatness belongs to bestowed bounty rather than self-exaltation
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكَبِيرُ}} ({{tr:al-kabīru}}) agrees with the bounty, so greatness modifies the named favor itself. The quality pattern presents stable magnitude rather than comparison, and the final position lets scale close the ayah. The same root can carry burdensome magnitude in this surah (42:13); here true greatness belongs to bestowed bounty.

topics.headline: greatness locked to bounty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader leaves the ayah with the scale and seriousness of bounty as the final word.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows for word 29 converge on greatness locked to bounty; local QAC grammar, attachment evidence, contextual profiles, and available dictionary guardrails support retaining the payoff.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The earning/falling pair at words 5 and 7 is opposed to intentional fitting work and the great bounty at words 11-12 and 23-24.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first cohort's self-acquisition returns as a fixed descent upon them. The second cohort contributes intentional, fitting action, but its result exceeds exchange because the destination is named as benefaction and surplus.

activation_trace.role: Self-directed acquisition supplies the stock whose consequence returns to its acquirers.
Falling together with fixation turns acquired action into an event now attached to them.
Purposive action marks the second cohort's real contribution.
Fitness and suitability make those acts constructive rather than merely numerous.
Unowed benefaction makes the final good exceed a wage-equivalent return.

changed_reading.before: A symmetrical punishment-for-bad and reward-for-good contrast.
changed_reading.after: An asymmetrical economy: harmful acquisition becomes its own arriving liability, while fitting work is answered by a gift larger than exchange.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The falling event at word 7 and the paired meadow, garden, and Lord terms at words 14, 15, and 20.
baseline_models.mechanism: The destination is a maintained habitat rather than decorative scenery: falling water, watering to saturation, tree-made enclosure, and gradual nurture compose a cultivated shelter.

activation_trace.role: Falling rain supplies the material descent that can feed the garden side of the contrast.
Watering until saturation makes the meadow an achieved condition of sufficiency.
A tree-enclosed orchard provides both growth and shelter.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the continuing maintenance of the habitat.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are a static reward backdrop.
changed_reading.after: The gardens are a saturated, enclosed, continuously tended ecology, set against a destructive kind of falling.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Seeing at word 1, fearful concern at word 3, fixed arrival at word 7, and concealment in the garden term at word 15.
baseline_models.mechanism: Vision, twilight-like fear, arrival, and concealment stage a threshold: hidden acquisition becomes perceptible as consequence, while the good destination remains a protective enclosure rather than public exposure.

activation_trace.role: Sensory or inward sight makes disclosure the frame of the whole scene.
The residual red light at sunset supplies a boundary image between visibility and darkness.
A fall that settles converts anticipation into disclosed actuality.
Covering and concealment make the believers' hiddenness protective rather than evasive.

changed_reading.before: The opening verb simply asks the addressee to observe two outcomes.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is also about a change of visibility: concealed deeds become an undeniable event, while sheltered life remains safely covered.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Desire at word 18 is governed by nearness at word 19, Lordship at word 20, and benefaction at word 23.
baseline_models.mechanism: Desired things are not presented as autonomous possessions. Their availability is located in nearness to the nurturing sovereign and summarized as gift, making relation the container of fulfilled desire.

activation_trace.role: Will directed toward things supplies desire without yet supplying ownership or production.
Proximity and presence locate fulfillment within a relation.
Sovereignty and ownership identify who holds the desired good.
Free benefaction identifies the mode by which desire is fulfilled.

changed_reading.before: The believers receive an unlimited inventory of whatever they want.
changed_reading.after: Fulfilled desire is relational availability near their Lord, received through benefaction rather than independent control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier gathering is explicitly divided into two separated groups, one in a garden and one in a blaze. The focus ayah becomes a close view of the states produced by that public sorting.

activation_trace.role: The enclosed orchard anchors the favorable destination in the focus.
A day and place that gathers people supplies the collective event behind the focus scene.
Separated cohorts turn the focus's conjunction into an adjudicated division.
The same orchard destination links the earlier group directly to the focus's believers.
Ignited fire supplies the adverse destination that the focus leaves implicit in the falling consequence.

structural_cues: 42:7 already pairs a group in the garden with a group in the blaze; 42:22 re-presents the bifurcation through fear and security.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, separated groups, garden, and blaze; I infer that 42:22 zooms into that same sorting. A live alternative is that 42:7 supplies only a thematic template, not an identical scene.

changed_reading.before: Two moral types are placed side by side.
changed_reading.after: The two types are viewed after a gathering has separated them into opposed destinations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, unbelievers hurry the Hour while believers fear it and know it is real. In the focus, fearful concern has migrated to the wrongdoers and the feared reality is no longer merely near: it is falling upon them.

activation_trace.role: Fear mixed with vigilant concern marks the wrongdoers' changed posture.
Settled arrival advances the scene from a nearing event to contact with its subjects.
Hurrying and bringing forward supplies the unbelievers' earlier, reckless posture toward the event.
The same concerned fear belongs earlier to believers, making its later transfer diagnostic.
Reality fixed against falsehood explains why the believers' earlier fear is lucid rather than panicked.

structural_cues: 42:17 calls the Hour near; 42:18 assigns concern to believers and haste to unbelievers; 42:22 reverses the emotional ownership.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated fear term and the near-to-falling sequence; I infer a temporal reversal at the same judgment horizon. The fear in 42:22 can still be read more narrowly as fear of deeds within that horizon.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers happen to be frightened by punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their fear is a belated acquisition of the posture believers held earlier, after reckless haste has become unavoidable arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: Desire selects a crop, cultivation produces a harvest, and increase exceeds the seed. The focus's garden therefore mediates between work and a result repeatedly enlarged through appreciative benefaction rather than paid at parity.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition anchors the negative side of the focus's productive economy.
Purposive work anchors the positive human input.
Saturated cultivation gives the harvest sequence a material destination.
Surplus beyond need or division names the excess yielded by the process.
Human willing chooses which harvest is sought and links desire to cultivation.
Sowing and tillage turn the two outcomes into rival cultivated futures.
Growth and increase supply the arrow from crop sought to crop enlarged.
An acquisition that clings to its doer links good acquisition back to the focus's harmful acquisition.
A little input showing an abundant effect explains amplification without wage-equivalence.
The explicit benefaction in the increase sequence confirms that enlargement is gifted.

structural_cues: 42:20 places two harvests immediately before the focus; 42:23 and 42:26 repeat increase after good acquisition and after righteous work.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies desire, crop, acquisition, increase, and benefaction; I infer that the focus garden is the realized harvest in this sequence. The live alternative is that the garden remains a destination image without describing the process of reward.

changed_reading.before: Righteous deeds purchase a garden reward.
changed_reading.after: Righteous work is seed in an amplified harvest: the garden is cultivated continuity, while the great bounty is the gifted excess over its input.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding wrongdoers participate in instituting an order attributed to partners without authorization, while decisive separation and judgment are deferred. Their focus-ayah fear is therefore attached to mislocated authority, not only private misconduct.

activation_trace.role: Putting something in the wrong place anchors the focus label as a disorder of proper authority.
Entering and opening an affair supplies the act of instituting the rival order.
Permission supplies the missing authorization that makes the institution wrongful.
A judgment separating true from false supplies the pending adjudication.
A cutting, binding decision explains why the consequence is delayed but fixed.
The repeated label directly carries the preceding institutional disorder into the focus.

structural_cues: 42:21 ends with the wrongdoers and their painful outcome; 42:22 begins by showing those same-labeled people fearing what they acquired.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rival partners, unauthorized institution, deferred judgment, and the repeated wrongdoer label; I infer continuity into 42:22. A live alternative is that the focus deliberately widens the label beyond the actors of 42:21.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers are an undifferentiated class of bad individuals.
changed_reading.after: At least one live referent is people who relocate norm-giving authority and then face the order their own institution produced.

context_deltas.mechanism: Unbounded worldly provision would produce transgression, so provision descends by measure; rain then descends after despair and spreads mercy by reviving growth. The focus garden becomes governed abundance: fully watered, but not the same as uncontrolled expansion.

activation_trace.role: Rainfall lets the focus's falling term participate in a life-giving descent as well as punitive descent.
Watering to saturation supplies the receiving ground for measured rain.
Thickening and intertwining vegetation supplies the visible product of that watering.
Expansion and abundance supply the dangerous counterfactual of provision without calibration.
An apportioned gift identifies abundance as distributed provision, not self-generated stock.
Measured planning supplies the control that prevents abundance from becoming transgression.
Life-giving rain supplies the material intervention after despair.
Rain reviving dried pasture supplies the arrow from descent to renewed habitat.
Tender mercy identifies the rain's social and affective value, not just its material effect.

structural_cues: 42:27-28 follows the focus's promise with a contrast between excessive spread, measured descent, rain after despair, and mercy spread.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured provision, rain, revived vegetation, and mercy; I infer that this sequence materializes the focus's watered gardens. The alternative is that the rain is a general analogy for mercy rather than a specification of the garden.

changed_reading.before: Great bounty means simply maximal quantity.
changed_reading.after: Great bounty is an expertly governed ecology: abundance arrives in the measure that can sustain life without reproducing transgression.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later causal formula makes a striking event arise from what hands acquired, but immediately says that much is erased from liability. The focus's falling consequence is therefore not a claim that every wrong mechanically lands; it can be the remainder after extensive pardon.

activation_trace.role: Self-acquisition anchors the focus's causal language.
A fall that fixes in place anchors the arriving consequence.
A calamity that strikes a person supplies the later parallel to falling upon them.
The repeated acquisition root explicitly preserves the causal link to action.
Hands as earners make agency concrete and block displacement of responsibility.
Leaving punishment and erasing fault interrupts a total one-to-one retribution rule.
Abundant quantity makes pardon a major subtraction rather than a marginal exception.

structural_cues: 42:30 repeats the acquisition-to-impact grammar but closes with pardon of much.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies causal impact and abundant pardon; I infer that what finally falls may be non-pardoned residue. The alternative is that 42:30 concerns temporal adversity while 42:22 concerns final judgment under a different accounting scope.

changed_reading.before: Every acquired wrong returns through an exhaustive mechanical equivalence.
changed_reading.after: Agency still has consequences, but the visible liability may be what remains after a large, prior act of pardon.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later contrast classifies whatever is merely given here as temporary use, while what is in divine presence is better and remains for believers who rely on their Lord. This makes nearness, not quantity alone, the durability mechanism of the focus promise.

activation_trace.role: Proximity and presence anchor where the promised good is held.
Continuance and abiding support the persistence of nearness.
Useful enjoyment supplies the limited category against which focus bounty is measured.
The repeated proximity construction identifies divine presence as the location of the superior good.
Chosen excellence ranks that held good above temporary use.
Continuance supplies the temporal property missing from worldly enjoyment.
Lordship joins enduring good to trust in its sovereign holder.

structural_cues: 42:36 repeats divine proximity and the believers' Lord relation while explicitly contrasting temporary and enduring goods.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the temporary-versus-enduring contrast and repeated proximity; I infer that proximity is what secures the focus promise's durability. The alternative is that proximity is idiomatic possession language with no distinct spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Whatever they desire is chiefly an unlimited quantity of objects.
changed_reading.after: The promise's decisive feature is that desired good is held in enduring nearness, unlike useful but expiring worldly grants.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later believer portrait makes fitting work social: deliberation, expenditure, proportionate defense, pardon, and reconciliation. It also narrows wrongdoing toward people to transgression beyond right, while protecting the wronged person's defense from that label.

activation_trace.role: Dealings among people make righteous work relational rather than merely private.
Removing estrangement gives the positive category a repair mechanism.
Withholding people from their rights gives the negative category a social object.
Extracting judgment through mutual review supplies a communal form of fitting action.
Wealth leaving its holder as expenditure reverses self-enclosing acquisition.
Forgoing punishment and erasing fault interrupts reciprocal escalation.
Reconciliation supplies the constructive goal of pardon.
Withholding human rights identifies who bears the adverse label in the legal sequence.
Crossing the limit through aggression distinguishes wrongdoing from proportionate defense.
Restraining the self from reactive collapse makes repair a sustained discipline.

structural_cues: 42:37-43 unfolds one continuous social portrait after 42:36's promise to believers, including an explicit distinction between defense after wrong and aggression against people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies these practices and legal distinctions; I infer that they instantiate the focus's two class labels. They may instead be selected examples under categories broader than this social mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Righteous deeds and wrongdoing are abstract moral totals.
changed_reading.after: They are visible social processes: consultation, circulation, restraint, and repair oppose withholding rights and transgressive aggression.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's act of seeing is replayed as the wrongdoers themselves see punishment, seek a route of return, are displayed upon it, and look only from a concealed edge. Public exposure and impaired looking invert the believers' protective concealment.

activation_trace.role: Mutual facing makes sight relational: observer and observed occupy one disclosed scene.
Protective covering anchors the favorable alternative to punitive exposure.
Repeated facing joins the addressee's sight to the wrongdoers' belated sight of punishment.
Return to a former place supplies the reversal they seek but cannot obtain.
A traversable path supplies the missing route out of the fixed event.
Being brought out for inspection turns the wrongdoers into publicly exposed objects.
Concealment contracts their own gaze even while their bodies are exposed.

structural_cues: 42:44 repeats both seeing and the wrongdoer label; 42:45 immediately expands the optics into display, abasement, and a hidden glance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the verbal reprise and exposure/hidden-looking sequence; I infer that it expands the focus's visual mechanics. The alternative is that the later scene is a second depiction rather than an unpacking of the focus.

changed_reading.before: The addressee neutrally sees frightened wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: The scene is an exposure regime: wrongdoers become fully visible just as their own sight contracts, while believers receive shelter rather than shame.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence repeatedly attaches willing to the creator and pairs it with giving without exchange. Human desire in the focus is therefore fulfilled inside a prior architecture of divine creation and gift, not by a second sovereign will.

activation_trace.role: Human will directed toward desired things anchors the promise that needs contextual scaling.
Sovereign ownership locates human willing under Lordship.
Benefaction identifies gift as the fulfillment mode.
Originating creation supplies the productive capacity behind available things.
Repeated divine willing places the same root on the creator side of the relation.
Giving without compensation supplies the concrete mode of divine provision.

structural_cues: 42:49-50 repeatedly alternates divine willing, creating, and gifting, after the focus locates human willing near the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated will root with changed subject plus creation and gift; I infer nested rather than competing wills. A live alternative is that the focus describes a transformed human will whose objects already harmonize with divine willing.

changed_reading.before: Human desire becomes an independent power to generate any object.
changed_reading.after: Human desire is freely fulfilled within the Lord's creative and gift-giving will; proximity grants access without transferring sovereignty.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's form-distant alternate mapping from the seeing root to a water-satiation root. It remains worth carrying because falling rain, saturation, enclosed vegetation, and later rain all converge on focus anchors. Downstream prose should present it as a latent water echo, never as a replacement translation of the opening verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening sight term, the falling term, and the meadow/garden pair at words 1, 7, 14, and 15.

activation_trace.role: The packet's alternate mapping contributes satiation after thirst as a form-distant echo behind the opening sight.
Rainfall gives the otherwise punitive descent a second, life-giving material possibility.
Watering to saturation realizes the alternate echo in the destination itself.
Dense vegetal growth supplies the result of received water.
Later life-giving rain verifies that the surah itself sustains the material circuit.

changed_reading.before: The two halves are linked only by moral contrast.
changed_reading.after: A secondary water circuit links them: one descent becomes fixed harm, while another descent answers thirst and produces the sheltered garden.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the twilight branch of fearful concern and extends an affective word into an optical sequence. It remains anchored through seeing, concealment, later exposure, hidden looking, and the surah's explicit light. Downstream prose should qualify it as an image-pattern, not claim that the fear term lexically means a complete light theology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Seeing and fearful concern at words 1 and 3, together with the concealed garden at word 15.

activation_trace.role: Sight supplies the governing optical action.
Sunset redness contributes unstable residual visibility at a threshold.
Covering supplies a hidden state that may protect rather than obscure truth.
Public display moves wrongdoers from twilight uncertainty into forced visibility.
Their hidden glance preserves impaired sight inside public exposure.
Explicit illumination supplies the opposite endpoint: light that enables guidance rather than exposure alone.

changed_reading.before: Fear is purely emotional and the opening sight is neutral.
changed_reading.after: The focus may sit at an optical threshold: wrongdoers retain only twilight-like, contracting vision, while guided sight belongs to a light that can coexist with protective concealment.

strongest_changes: The fear term reverses ownership between 42:18 and 42:22: believers fear while the Hour is near, but wrongdoers fear once consequence is arriving.
The harvest, increase, and appreciative-gift sequence turns the garden from a wage into an amplified crop whose excess is benefaction.
Measured rain and revived growth make the bounty a governed ecology rather than uncontrolled quantity.
The repeated acquisition-impact formula is interrupted by abundant pardon, revising strict mechanical retribution.
The later legal-social sequence makes righteous action into consultation, circulation, restraint, and repair, and defines wrongdoing through violated rights and aggression.
The later seeing scene expands the focus into an inversion of visibility: wrongdoers are exposed while their own gaze contracts.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah repetition repeatedly changed the focus without collapsing it to one reading: fear changed temporal ownership, work became cultivation, bounty became amplified yet measured provision, and sight became a relation between exposure and shelter. The packet's non-dominant water mapping and twilight branch also produced contained but live cross-domain readings.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the group split in 42:7 is the identical scene viewed in 42:22 or a recurring template.
Whether pardon in 42:30 limits final liability in 42:22 or only explains temporal adversity.
How human fulfilled desire relates to repeated divine willing: nested access and transformed desire both remain live.
The hydrological and twilight models are packet-anchored but may be branch-driven echoes rather than intended organizing mechanisms.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **What was acquired returns as a fixed falling event.** Lexical evidence: ك س ب `B001` (seeking and obtaining), ش ف ق `B003` (care mixed with fear), and و ق ع `B001` (falling into fixed reality) with `B002` (overwhelming descent). Structural cue and role: fear arises **مِمَّا كَسَبُوا**, and the pronoun makes that acquisition the thing now falling upon them. Abductive move: I infer a return-path from voluntary acquisition to unavoidable occurrence. Reading change: consequence is the matured form of what agents obtained, not an unrelated external addition.

2. **Gardened concealment is spacious rather than restrictive.** Lexical evidence: ر و ض `B004` (spaciousness of place and breath), ج ن ن `B001` (covering/concealment) and `B003` (tree-covered garden), and ف ض ل `B001` (excess) plus `B003` (bounty). Structural cue and role: believers are **فِى رَوْضَاتِ ٱلْجَنَّاتِ**, then receive what they will in divine presence. Abductive move: I infer that the garden's covering produces protected spaciousness, answering the exposed fear in the first half. Reading change: concealment here is a breathable shelter of surplus, not deprivation of sight.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:45's repeated **تَرَى** and explicit loss reverse this scene: what is feared here as an acquired event is later fully exposed, while protected spaciousness becomes loss of self and household for the other group.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The same apprehension changes character across the causal threshold.** **Lexical evidence:** ش ف ق `B003` (care mixed with fear), anchored in مُشْفِقِينَ, and ك س ب `B001` (obtaining gain for oneself), anchored in كَسَبُوا۟. **Structural cue:** 42:18 called believers مُشْفِقُونَ before the Hour while joining fear to knowledge; here wrongdoers are مُشْفِقِينَ after confronting what they acquired. **Assigned role:** the repeated affect marks two positions relative to consequence: informed anticipation versus recoil from one's own accumulation. **Abductive move:** I infer that causal position, not the emotion alone, distinguishes the two groups. **Reading change:** fear is not a fixed sign of belief or unbelief; it can be responsible foresight or belated recognition.
2. **Acquired acts land, while bounty exceeds strict landing.** **Lexical evidence:** و ق ع `B001` (falling into occurrence and fixed reality), ص ل ح `B001` (soundness against corruption), ج ن ن `B003` (tree-covered garden), and ف ض ل `B003` (beneficence and bounty). **Structural cue:** earned consequence is said to fall upon one group, while the other receives what it wills plus great bounty; 42:25-26 add pardon, response, and increase. **Assigned role:** وقوع realizes accumulated action, gardens spatialize sound action, and فضل marks an excess not reducible to matching return. **Abductive move:** I infer two coexisting causal modes, consequence that lands and bounty that exceeds, without merging them. **Reading change:** the contrast is not a single symmetrical ledger; one side realizes its acquisition, while the other enters a generative surplus.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:25-26 corrected a strict landing ledger by adding informed pardon, response, and increase. 42:27 then related bounty to measured provision, making surplus and calibration coexist rather than cancel each other.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Mercy is given a full ecological mechanism, from follow-up rain and revived pasture to saturation, depressions, and rock basins that retain water.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Garden as Receiving Vessel
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A sheltered garden receives measured water, becomes saturated, and stores excess in hollows and stone basins.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: tree-hidden garden `quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`; measured waterbag amount `quranic:root_000611:B002/m01`; saturation and quenching `quranic:root_000611:B003/m01`; water-holding depression `quranic:root_001675:B008/m01`; rock basin retaining rain `quranic:root_000434:B011/m01`; fertile yielding earth `quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: ج ن ن at 42:22; ر و ض at 42:22; و ق ع at 42:22; خ ل ق at 42:29; ء ر ض at 42:27, 42:29.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The garden is not a decorative endpoint but a receiving apparatus. Measured water quenches the soil, while depressions and rock hollows retain what would otherwise pass away.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Authentication by Inscription
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Speech is fixed as text, impressed with a seal, signed, and thereby established as true.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görmeyi hem gözle algılama hem de gözün işlevine benzetilen içsel kavrayış olarak kuruyor. Doğrudan göz tanıklığı bu çekirdeğin duyusal gerçekleşimidir; zihinsel görüş, uyku düşü ve başkalarına görünme amacı bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği görsel ya da içsel algıdır; belirli söz öbekleri ve bakma çabası ayrı kullanımlar olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın görme çekirdeği ile doğrudan göz tanıklığını ve görmeye çalışma bildiren bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi gözle ya da göz işlevi gören içsel kavrayışla algılamaktır. Gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan görme, bu anlamın duyusal ve tanıklığa dayalı gerçekleşimidir.

facets.statement: Görülebilir bir şeyi gözle veya benzer bir içsel kavrayışla algılama.
Bir şeyi gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan ve tanık olarak görme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, gözle görmeyi temel alır ve bazı anlatımlarda bu algıyı içsel kavrayışa kadar genişletir; doğrudan göz tanıklığı özellikle belirtilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak ekseni, bir konu hakkında zihinsel bir yargı veya görüş oluşturmaktır. Bilme ya da sanma değeri belirli tümce yapılarında, danışma ise başka birinin görüşünü istemede ortaya çıkar; bunlar yalın çekirdeğin eş düzeyli anlamları sayılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Görüş, kanı ve düşünerek karar verme çekirdektir; bilme, sanma ve danışma yapıya bağlı gerçekleşimlerdir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın zihinsel yargı ile düşünme, danışma ve göz tanıklığına bağlı sanma kullanımları ayrı kapsamlarla gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir konu hakkında düşünüp zihinde bir görüş, kanı veya yargı oluşturmaktır. Derinlemesine düşünme bu sonuca götüren süreçtir; danışma başka birinin yargısını isteme, belirli tümce yapılarıysa bilme ya da sanma değeridir.

facets.statement: Bir konu hakkında zihinde görüş, kanı veya yargı oluşturma.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi açıkça uyuyan kişinin uykuda gördüğü şeyi ve bunun çoğulunu bildirir. Uyanıkken gözle görmek, zihinsel görüş ve düşü yorumlama bu kimliğin parçası değildir.
